title: Chinese spy balloon as standard of evidence

tellings.quote: Much like the Chinese spy balloon that floated over US airspace in 2023. Everybody sees it.

plain: In 2023 a Chinese spy balloon drifted across American skies, and everybody could see it. Michael Shermer, a researcher and skeptic who debated the host, brings it up without naming a source. He offers it as the kind of plain, shared evidence he says a real visiting craft would also leave.
